description: Repères de crue is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Toulouse. Location of the landmarks of the historic flood of 1875 in the town of Toulouse. Coverage: Mairie de Toulouse. The portal shows the English title as "Flood markers" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mairie de Toulouse. Its keywords include reperes, patrimoine, crue, historique, 1875. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
